sessions.transcript_text:
Contact Summary: Completed initial Reentry Navigation consultation with Nathaniel via phone. Explained the expectations and benefits of both the full-time in-person program and the Reentry Navigation program. Nathaniel is currently working a 3rd-shift sanitation job but is seeking more stable, higher-paying employment. He resides with his mother, has his own vehicle, and possesses a valid driver's license. Placed client on the waitlist for the Columbia full-time program. 

Case Plan Goal Progress & Briefcase Updates: Verified that client has access to his Birth Certificate, Social Security Card, State ID, valid Driver's License, and a completed resume (Briefcase Gate 1). Client expressed long-term goals of obtaining a CDL and gaining skills in carpentry/electrical trades to help renovate family properties. 

Referrals/Resources Provided: Navigator is sending a job application link for a warehouse position at Trane Technologies ($21-$25/hr).

Next Steps: Navigator to consult with the Columbia Center Director (Jen) regarding client's need to pick up children at 2:30 PM on certain days to see if an accommodation can be made for the full-time program. Navigator to research local training programs for carpentry and electrical trades. Client to review and submit the application to Trane Technologies.
